name: sing-rampant2
title: Rampant 2
author: Antarctic_Singularity
description:
Advanced AI and enemy overhaul for Factorio 2.0. Originally based on Rampant 1.1.1 by Veden, significantly expanded and adapted for Space Age by Dimm2101, now maintained by Antarctic_Singularity.

Features improved enemy tactics with potential fields/pheromones, unit swarming, tactical retreats, breaching behavior, and faction mutations. Units can attack from afar and learn your defenses. Works across all planets: Nauvis, Gleba, and Vulcanus.
